M-FVUI.Purpose: High-level declarative entry point (FVUI) in the root FlexVerse namespace: route host rects and widget trees to their keyed WidgetEngine without caller-managed fields.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: FVUI static class: Render, Release, and GetEngine.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Coordination between host-provided Rect boundaries and EngineRegistry.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Window stack, window lifecycle, and native IMGUI event loop — owned by the game host (RimWorld WindowStack).
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Tree reconciliation and layout calculation — owned by M-WIDGET-ENGINE.

Principles.PRIN-001: Guest engine contract: UI never manages window instances or screen buffers; it strictly renders within the Rect provided by the host.
Principles.PRIN-002: Stateless caller ergonomics: FVUI.Render provides a single-line call site for host draw hooks (DoWindowContents, GizmoOnGUI).
Principles.PRIN-003: Domain separation: lives as a distinct static class FVUI inside namespace FlexVerse alongside sibling facades (Animate, etc.); the FV prefix keeps it conflict-free next to Verse.UI in host code.

Requirements.REQ-001: FVUI.Render(key, rect, root) resolves the engine via EngineRegistry.GetOrCreate(key) and drives WidgetEngine.ProcessUI(root, rect), returning layout results.
Requirements.REQ-002: FVUI.Release(key) delegates directly to EngineRegistry.Release(key), returning true if the engine was present and released.
Requirements.REQ-003: Repeated FVUI.Render calls with the same key across frames preserve instance tree identity and reconciliation state.
Requirements.REQ-004: FVUI.GetEngine(key) delegates to EngineRegistry.Get(key), returning the engine or null without throwing.

Inputs.IN-001: key: string — stable identifier of the rendering context.
Inputs.IN-002: rect: Rect — available screen/window area supplied by host.
Inputs.IN-003: root: Widget — declarative widget definition tree for the frame.

Outputs.OUT-001: IReadOnlyDictionary<Widget, Rect> — layout results from WidgetEngine.ProcessUI.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Issues IMGUI draw calls and dispatches input events within rect.

M-FVUI.Codemap: * `FVUI.{Render|Release|GetEngine}` * `FVUI.Render(key, rect, root)` -> `EngineRegistry.GetOrCreate(key)` -> `WidgetEngine.ProcessUI(root, rect)` * `FVUI.Release(key)` -> `EngineRegistry.Release(key)` * `FVUI.GetEngine(key)` -> `EngineRegistry.Get(key)` * `FVUI` : static facade in root `FlexVerse` namespace
